notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM's voting share (0.9%) is below its ownership share because of the high-vote Class B and F shares. CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (Class A shares). The CalPERS percentage divides its shares by all three classes outstanding on the Q3 2026 10-Q cover (October 26, 2026), the same counts used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: the count is Class A holders of record; the 10-K also gives 16 Class B holders and one Class F holder.
